messages:
maria: Heads-up — acme-corp reports Console hourly usage lagging ~3.5h. Gap visible starting ~2026-03-16T23:45Z. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acme-corp/usage
ingest-bot: alert: hourly-ingest-pipeline error at 2026-03-16T23:47Z — reason=CoordinatorLockTimeout job_id=ingest-2490011223
aj: checking consumer group 'hourly-rollups' now
aj: output:
``n$ kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group hourly-rollups
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
hourly-raw         7         334450          402900           68450
``
lee: that's a big lag, explains the multi-hour delay. any backfills in flight? backfill-coordinator shows status=STALLED for window 2026-03-16T23:00-2026-03-17T03:00
sam: I tried bouncing consumer on infra-rollup-03; commit keeps timing out. logs:
``nERROR Commit timeout waiting for coordinator response (timeout=25s) at coordinator/commit.py:142
``
maria: customer is P2; need ETA to restore per-hour rows and confirm billing unaffected. Is a tenant-scoped backfill acceptable?
lee: recommend a tenant-scoped, limited backfill to avoid cluster-wide pressure. Command I propose:
``n./tools/backfill_tenant.sh \
  --tenant acme-corp \
  --start 2026-03-16T23:00 --end 2026-03-17T03:00 \
  --mode fast-scan --no-heavy-joins \
  --priority high
``
This should finish ~25-50m depending on DB contention.
aj: also applied producer throttling on topic hourly-raw to ~1500 msgs/s to let consumers catch up
sam: kicked off tenant-only backfill job backfill-2490011223-acme-01 with reduced join strategy. Initial progress: 1.2% after 3m. Monitoring for DB lock escalations.
maria: please confirm when first hour rows show up in Console before I tell customer. Also check billing delta for that tenant for the gap period.
lee: partial data visible — first backfilled hourly row for 23:00 appeared at 2026-03-17T00:15Z; console refresh shows 23:00 and 00:00 rows for acme-corp :white_check_mark:
aj: quick root-cause notes: observed a Kafka controller re-election at 2026-03-16T23:43Z during an infra rolling deploy; leader reshuffle caused temporary unavailability for partition leaders and the backfill-coordinator held synchronous locks waiting on worker commits, which hit CoordinatorLockTimeout. Mitigations: make coordinator lock acquisition async with retries and implement non-blocking worker heartbeats; also sequence infra rolling upgrades to avoid concurrent controller flips.
sam: created ticket INFRA-4921 and draft PR to change coordinator commit path (link: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4829). Also adding a safe-mode for backfills to detect prolonged commit timeouts and auto-switch to incremental mode.
maria: thanks. I'll relay this to the customer with ETA ~45m for full visibility and note billing should be unaffected but we'll confirm after full replay. Ping if anything regresses or any unexpected billing anomalies appear.
